pins.name: A
pins.notes: Anode (long leg), through the resistor to a GPIO

gotchas.text: The long leg (anode) goes to the pin, the short leg to GND, always through a resistor (220 Ω to 1 kΩ).

sources.title: Generic 5 mm LED
sources.section: Forward voltage about 2 V (red); 220 Ω at 3.3 V gives about 6 mA
